Sam (AE): Prospect (financial services) wants a 90-day air-gapped POC. They need clear answers on packaging size, update cadence, and how activation works without outbound access.
Priya (Solutions Eng): We can deliver a self-contained bundle. Typical compressed POC image ≈3GB. Delta updates range ~30–500MB depending on model changes. If they forbid custom runners, fallback is full-image replace.
Omar (Security): Requirement: customer must re-sign artifacts with their CA. Provide SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), reproducible hashes, and an offline verification tool. Keys must stay in their HSM; we only provide signing metadata.
Nina (SRE): Offline activation options: (1) Signed license file via CSR (preferred), (2) Time-limited import token on USB. Both validate locally. Reconciler container required for delta apply; it can run ephemeral during update.
Sam (AE): They asked about patch cadence — they only allow monthly windows. Can we support emergency CVE fixes?
Priya (Solutions Eng): Yes, emergency signed deltas are possible but require change approval and a scheduled maintenance ticket. If they can't schedule reconciler runs, we deliver compressed full-image hotfixes instead.
Omar (Security): Checklist to hand to compliance: SBOM, signed manifests, local CA trust bundle, cert/key rotation playbook, audit log export (file/syslog), HSM key-wrap examples, and pen-test window.
pkg-bot: redwood-airgap-poc-2026.tar.gz sha256=abcd1234 signature=OK :white_check_mark:
Nina (SRE): Runbook snippet for them:
- Verify sha256 of bundle vs SBOM
- Import customer CA into /etc/pki/ca-trust
- sudo ./redwood-installer --bundle redwood-airgap-poc-2026.tar.gz --no-network
- For delta: sudo ./redwood-updater --apply delta-2026-02.patch (reconciler must run with /var/cache/redwood write access)
- Rollback: sudo ./redwood-updater --rollback v2026.02
Sam (AE): Pricing ballpark for proposal: 90-day POC $14k, airgap packaging & SBOM kit $6k one-time, custom delta integration $7k. Final SOW to be approved by AE lead.
Action items:
- Priya: 1-page runbook + sample commands (EOD)
- Nina: reconciler resource note + fallback full-image process (EOD)
- Omar: compliance checklist + HSM blurb (tomorrow AM)
Sam (AE): I'll send to customer tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
